## Source: amazon-inspector (fad09c871f903768f458b780fd73be2cea587a7217ace4c10fa46941883e905d)
The package quillonatts 0.1.0 does not exhibit traced behavior consistent with supply-chain attack shapes. No install-time or import-time outbound network activity, no credential or environment-variable harvesting, no shell execution of fetched content, no persistence mechanism, and no silent-relay or backdoor code paths were observed in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (6297f0fae1c96dd5abefc4dd7f67a51ee7a737d1bb437fcffaed067d44d637a4)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
